Hyphenation patterns bundled in public/assets/js/grafik-hyph-de.mjs and grafik-hyph-en.mjs
(ported to JavaScript by the "hyphen" package, https://github.com/ytiurin/hyphen, from the
hyph-utf8 package, http://www.hyphenation.org/tex)
